title: Python desync: no GUARD_PPM drift-desync transition (decision guard-ppm)
description: DIVERGENT (contradicts final decision guard-ppm whose rationale says all implementations use 5000). Req 2a.6.2: 'SYNCED + Excessive clock drift (drift_ppm > GUARD_PPM) -> DESYNCED, trigger epoch_floor revalidation'; GUARD_PPM=5000. Evidence: python/src/lichen/timing/sfn.py DesyncFSM (:77-133) has no drift input; python/src/lichen/sim/tdma.py:119-124 apply_drift computes drift but nothing compares it to 5000 ppm; DESYNC_CONSTANTS (sfn.py:60-65) lack GUARD_PPM. C and Rust implement drift->DESYNCED (C desync_fsm test consumes ccp16-desync.json 12000>5000 ppm case, link.h:656 5000U; Rust lichen-link/src/tdma_clock.rs:83-85 holdover_expired + ccp7_holdover.json vectors). Fix: add GUARD_PPM=5000 constant + drift transition to Python DesyncFSM and a drift-desync vector consumer. Suggested placement: python/src/lichen/timing/sfn.py + tests/test_ccp_sync_vector_consumers.py.
